- Develop a user-facing project for managing virtual event bookings and payments.

- Handle core risks: payment fraud and data breaches.

### Phase 2. PRD
#### docs/PRD.md
```markdown
## Problem
Managing virtual event bookings and payments securely and efficiently is challenging. Risks include payment fraud and data breaches. The core flow involves users creating accounts, booking events, and paying for services.

## Users
- Event organizers
- Users (event attendees)

## Goals and Non-goals
- Goal: Allow event organizers to securely manage bookings and payments.
- Non-goal: Implement all possible features; some features are out of scope for this initial phase.

## Functional Requirements (FR-01 to FR-10)
| FR ID | Description | Acceptance Criteria |
|-------|------------|---------------------|
| FR-01 | Users can create accounts. | Given a user visits the registration page, When they fill out the registration form and submit, Then the system should create a new user account. |
| FR-02 | Users can log in and log out. | Given a user visits the login page, When they enter their credentials and submit, Then the system should log them in. Given a user visits the logout page, When they click the logout button, Then the system should log them out. |
| FR-03 | Users can book events. | Given a user visits the event page, When they select an event and click the book button, Then the system should add the event to their booking list. |
| FR-04 | Users can view their booking list. | Given a user visits their profile, When they click the 'View Booking List' button, Then the system should display their current bookings. |
| FR-05 | Users can pay for services directly. | Given a user visits the payment page, When they select a payment method and click the pay button, Then the system should process the payment. |
| FR-06 | Users can pay through a third-party payment gateway. | Given a user visits the payment page, When they select a third-party payment gateway, Then the system should redirect to the payment gateway and return the result. |
| FR-07 | Users can cancel bookings. | Given a user visits their profile, When they select a booking and click the cancel button, Then the system should remove the booking from their list. |
| FR-08 | Users can receive confirmation emails. | Given a user completes a booking, When the system processes the payment, Then the system should send a confirmation email to the user. |
| FR-09 | Users can manage their accounts (edit personal information, reset password). | Given a user visits their profile, When they click the 'Manage Account' button, Then the system should display a form to edit their personal information and a form to reset their password. |
| FR-10 | Users can view payment history. | Given a user visits their profile, When they click the 'View Payment History' button, Then the system should display a list of their past payments. |

## Non-functional Requirements (FR-11 to FR-14)
| FR ID | Description | Acceptance Criteria |
|-------|------------|---------------------|
| FR-11 | Payment security. | The system should handle payment fraud and data breaches using secure methods such as encryption and tokenization. |
| FR-12 | Data privacy. | User data should be encrypted and stored securely to comply with privacy regulations. |
| FR-13 | Scalability. | The system should be able to handle a large number of users and events without performance issues. |
| FR-14 | Availability. | The system should be available 24/7 without downtime. |
